business_days_closed_consistent.name: business_days_closed_consistent
business_days_closed_consistent.value: "business_days"."status" <> 'CLOSED' OR ("business_days"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "business_days"."closed_by_id" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_signed_has_number.name: fiscal_signed_has_number
fiscal_signed_has_number.value: "fiscal_receipts"."status" <> 'SIGNED' OR ("fiscal_receipts"."invoice_number" IS NOT NULL AND "fiscal_receipts"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL)

order_items_void_has_reason.name: order_items_void_has_reason
order_items_void_has_reason.value: "order_items"."status" <> 'VOIDED' OR ("order_items"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."voided_by_id" IS NOT NULL)

printers_network_cfg.name: printers_network_cfg
printers_network_cfg.value: "printers"."connection" <> 'NETWORK_ESCPOS' OR ("printers"."host" IS NOT NULL AND "printers"."port" BETWEEN 1 AND 65535)

stock_documents_posted_has_number.name: stock_documents_posted_has_number
stock_documents_posted_has_number.value: "stock_documents"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR "stock_documents"."number" IS NOT NULL OR "stock_documents"."posted_at" IS NULL
